title: Deleting an unknown item must answer 404
goal: Clients can tell a successful delete from a delete of something that was never there.

acceptance_criteria.text: DELETE /todos/:id of an id that does not exist (or was already deleted) answers 404 (reported: it answers 204).
Deleting an existing item still answers 204; a test covers both cases.

context.notes: Find the cause and add a test that fails without the fix.
